activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: She is having repaired her bicycle at the moment.
cards.explanation: El objeto debe ir entre el verbo y el participio: is having her bicycle repaired.

cards.statement: The theatre will have replacing the seats before opening night.
cards.explanation: Después de will have necesitamos un objeto y un participio: will have the seats replaced.

cards.statement: The family had their roof repaired after the winter storm.
cards.explanation: Had their roof repaired indica que encargaron la reparación.

cards.statement: Can we have the report translate by Friday?
cards.explanation: Después del objeto report necesitamos el participio translated.

cards.statement: You must have the permit signed before construction begins.
cards.explanation: Must have + objeto + signed expresa una obligación administrativa.

cards.statement: He had his wallet steal on the bus.
cards.explanation: El participio correcto es stolen: had his wallet stolen.

cards.statement: I will have the lock changing before the tenants arrive.
cards.explanation: La causativa requiere el participio changed, no el gerundio changing.

cards.statement: The hotel gets its carpets clean every Friday.
cards.explanation: La causativa requiere el participio cleaned, no el adjetivo o forma base clean.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

cards.statement: Mina has just got her visa approved.

cards.statement: The shop had its window broken during the demonstration.
